ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B3-3,
Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 7-M in the
area bound by:

      West Diversey Avenue, North Meade Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to
      West Diversey Avenue; and a line 57.36 feet west of and parallel to North Meade
      Avenue,

to those of a B3-1, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                        ___________________________

                                                        Ruth Cruz
                                                        Alderwoman, 30th Ward
 Common Address:

6101-6107 W. Diversey Avenue
